verdict.rationale: GitLab clearly has merge requests, its pull-request equivalent: issues can become merge requests, code review happens on them, security findings appear in them, and projects can set MR review instructions. A community report says the GitHub importer carries over pull requests and review comments, which implies review comments are a native concept. Missing for 10: any first-party evidence of diff comparison views, explicit documentation of inline line-level review comments, and hands-on confirmation of the review workflow.
